# <span id="aanchor379"></span> Main Screen

The FLOWCAL main screen includes the main menu, the Settings menu icon, and a customizable dashboard that includes quick launch tiles, exception data, location gain/loss balance information and “Did you know?” tips.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," style="width: 858;height: 475;" />

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Main Menu">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Main Menu</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Main Menu">

The main menu contains six sub-menus:

- Import
- Review
- Open
- Reports
- Setup
- Tools



<img src="data:image/png;base64," style="width: 613;height: 489;" />

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Dashboard">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Dashboard</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Dashboard">

Use the customizable dashboard to display and arrange links to frequently used tasks, exception data for specified lists, gain/loss balance information for locations, and "Did you know?" tips for improving your FLOWCAL experience.

All of these features are customizable in the [Dashboard Manager](../Dashboard%20Manager/Dashboard%20Manager.md).

#### See also:

- [Quick Launch Tiles](../Dashboard%20Manager/Dashboard%20Manager_Quick%20Launch.md)

- [Exception Resolver Widget](../Dashboard%20Manager/Dashboard%20Manager_Exception%20Resolver.md)
- [Gain/Loss Balance Tool](../Dashboard%20Manager/Dashboard%20Manager_Gain-Loss%20Balance%20Tool.md)
- [Did you know? Tips](../Dashboard%20Manager/Dashboard%20Manager_DYK.md)

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Settings Menu">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Settings Menu</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Settings Menu">

The Settings menu contains links to commonly used configuration options. Click the gear icon 

<img src="data:image/png;base64," style="width: 19;height: 19;" /> on the main screen to open the Settings menu and access the following options:

- [Settings Manager](../Settings%20Manager/Settings%20Manager.md)
- [Dashboard Manager](../Dashboard%20Manager/Dashboard%20Manager.md)
- [Change Password](../Admin%20Options/Change%20Password.md)
- [Logout/Login](../Admin%20Options/Logout-Login.md)

</div>
